Ordinance

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

Section 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by the changing all of the RT-4 Residential Two-Flat,
Townhouse and Multi-Unit District symbols and indications as shown on Map No.
18-C in the area bound by:

East 76th Street; South Jeffery Boulevard; a line commencing 107.99 feet south of
East 76th Street and traveling in a northwesterly direction along the southwesterly
right of way line of the Baltimore, Pittsburgh and Chicago Railroad; and the public
alley next west of and parallel to South Jeffery Boulevard

to those of B3-2 Community Shopping District.

Section 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.

Common Address of Property: 7600 S. Jeffery Boulevard, Chicago, Illinois.
